title: Tazas de Café de Dibujos Animados con Personajes Doodle Juguetones sobre Fondo Pastel
prompt: Cartoon illustration of coffee cups in a clean minimalist studio environment. All objects maintain realism and three-dimensional depth but are transformed into expressive cartoon characters: Each cup has a friendly smiling face with big eyes showing cheerful and welcoming emotions, some cups are dancing or high-fiving each other. Doodle lines are black, slightly uneven, hand-drawn like quick expressive sketchbook strokes drawn directly on the objects. Style: Mix of realistic product photography and cartoon doodle overlay. Background: Pure pastel mint green, clean and minimal. Lighting: Soft, even, studio-style with subtle highlights and soft shadows, no harsh light. Mood: Playful and energetic. Keywords: Hybrid photo doodle, product cartoon, expressive characters, minimalist soft background.
